correctness.rationale: For every 0<a<1 and every nondecreasing data vector, the increment decomposition is an exact convex combination of two constant vectors and three step vectors. The terminal and central step interpolants are explicit cubics, whose entire closed-interval extrema are determined from exactly differentiated polynomials. Their negative and positive excursions are E(a) and H(a), giving the exact global defect max(E,H). Strict increase of E and strict decrease of H on (0,1), together with opposite endpoint limits, proves the unique minimizer at their crossing. verify.py on the actual package path passes symbolic identities and exact rational square-root sign checks at 0.4458209224 and 0.4458209226; random tests are neither needed nor represented as an infinite proof.
